description:
Per county: rows on the official tax sale list, the next and last sale dates, the total of the published
        amounts, the list's own date and the last refresh, the office and list URL, the statute, the cited bidding and
        redemption rules and how to bid, and whether HeritageDeed's title search covers the county. Optional `state`
        (code or name) narrows it.
name: tax_sale_summary
